content: CRT visualizations center on a number-line showing each modulus's residue class as a repeating highlighted pattern, with the simultaneous solution shown as the intersection point of all patterns. Calculators (miniwebtool) pair this with an Extended-Euclidean-Algorithm step breakdown feeding the construction method, plus a verification step. Ring/clock-face representations (one circle per modulus) are an alternative to the number-line for showing residues, echoing the project's own existing 'Congruence Wheel' pattern.
